description: platformAutomerge is off because GitHub-native auto-merge is unusable on this repo (private repo on a free plan: branch protection is unavailable and 'Allow auto-merge' is off); Renovate merges PRs itself instead.

packageRules.description: Batch all base-image digest bumps into one self-merging PR per week. These carry no review value (PRs run no CI; the real multi-arch build runs post-merge on main and only republishes :stable/:8.5 on success), so let Renovate group, schedule, and merge them. ignoreTests is required because Renovate otherwise waits for a green status that never comes (no checks = never green, never failed, so the PR is neither merged nor assigned).
